practical_review: Original fixed primitives and supported policy domains supplied in manuscript/input/README. Demand, competitive output, import quantities and current numeraire feasibility checked. Global small-country allocation(12,4,16/3) has explicit completed-square surplus gap, not a grid-optimum assertion.

Current numeraire output200 is exhausted by energy intermediate inputs, household numeraire, G20, A-owned investment10 and exports20. Two independent nominal GDP routes agree; carbon/permit receipts not double-counted. Tariff nominal factor287/261 equals base-price factor260/261 times deflator287/260. Price-weighted GDP is not welfare.

Government primary surplus-4, interest2, mature25, issue31 and end debt56 reconcile. The public interest payment is the same net primary income-2 counted once. GNI/GNDI, saving, CA and public/private external funding close for each policy.

Complete two-date settlement: household terminal endowment100 each, private opening FU positions equally owned with net terminal receipt11/2 each, unchanged terminal exchange rate11/5 and no further interest. All public principal56 is repaid with tax28 each; A receives investment output10; new private borrowing b is repaid once. Terminal consumption175/2-b and155/2-b sums to210+ending NFA. Subtracting common161/2 from each full utility gives adjusted constants89 and90, preserving all welfare comparisons.

CA19-8M=FA, with private net borrowing8M-25 and public6; negative private borrowing is recorded as asset acquisition. Opening NFA-40 plus FX valuation1 plus financial transactions gives closing NFA. End-period HC financing is not revalued again.

Pilot lottery date May1 follows April baseline without anticipation. Latest eligible releases at June15 yield changes(-2,-2,0,0,1,1), contrast-2,20 equal-probability assignments and inclusive sharp-null p1/5. July revision changes contrast to-5/3 despite unchanged p1/5. Uniform fixed treatment count is not independent Bernoulli assignment; zero average null is not the individual sharp null.

Pilot information-offer target differs from national structural energy policy. No empirical demand, damage, foreign supply, compliance or general-equilibrium parameter is inferred from the six-community design. Memo rubric requires conditional implementation, compensating transfers and defended changed-input analysis.
